summary.top: Orna Porat Theater for Children and Youth

question: What high-value family-content sources is NestUp currently missing in Tel Aviv?

currentCoverage.method: Compared official candidate calendars with active production provider and source-host coverage on 2026-08-21

sources.name: Orna Porat Theater for Children and Youth
sources.notes: High event volume and explicit Tel Aviv venue/date/ticket details; location filtering required because touring events are nationwide.

sources.name: Israel Philharmonic for Children
sources.contentType: family concerts and musical story time
sources.notes: Strong structured dates, venue, price, age and ticket links; seasonal rather than daily.

sources.name: Steinhardt Museum of Natural History — Families
sources.notes: Dedicated family category and age-specific programming.

sources.name: Tel Aviv Museum of Art — Families
sources.contentType: museum workshops, tours and family films
sources.notes: Dedicated family calendar with dates, times, ages and event pages; verify DigiTel overlap by occurrence before integration.

sources.name: Israeli Opera — Children's Opera
sources.contentType: children's opera and backstage family programs
sources.notes: Official series pages and ticketing; low cadence but high-value content.

sources.name: ANU Museum of the Jewish People — Events
sources.contentType: museum activities for families and youth
sources.notes: Mixed adult/family calendar requires strict relevance filtering.

sources.name: Cameri Theatre — Children's Shows
sources.notes: Official calendar has occurrence times; taxonomy currently mixes academy content and needs a strict child-show gate.

sources.name: MUZA, Eretz Israel Museum
sources.contentType: museum workshops, planetarium and family events
sources.notes: Family value is strong but event discovery is distributed across museum pages.

sources.name: Suzanne Dellal — Family and Kids Programming
sources.contentType: family dance, workshops and seasonal festival
sources.notes: High-value seasonal content; dedicated summer festival overlaps DigiTel for some performances.

sources.name: Bialik House — Activities
sources.contentType: story time, family tours and workshops
sources.notes: Useful neighborhood content but lower freshness and likely municipal overlap; connector feasibility needs inspection.
